And here's the thing about Hannah, and I say this with love: she is the most generous, loyal, deeply feeling person I have ever met. I watched her laugh at your jokes that aren't funny — and Andrew, they are not funny — and I realized you don't just love Hannah. You *understand* her. He waited fifteen minutes outside a restaurant. He's earned it.
